task.instruction: Compare the prices of the latest models of MacBook Air available on Apple's website.

final_answer:
The latest MacBook Air models on Apple's US store are the M5 versions in 13-inch and 15-inch sizes. These are the starting prices the page shows:

| Model | Chip option | Starting price | Apple Card Monthly Installments (12 months) | Apple Upgrade lease (36 months) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 13-inch | M5, 10-core CPU / 8-core GPU | $1,299 | $108.25/mo | from $24.99/mo |
| 13-inch | M5, 10-core CPU / 10-core GPU | $1,399 | $116.58/mo | from $27.07/mo |
| 15-inch | M5, 10-core CPU / 10-core GPU | $1,499 | $124.91/mo | from $28.99/mo |

- **Size:** The 15-inch starts $200 above the base 13-inch. It is $100 above the 13-inch with the same 10-core GPU.
- **GPU:** On the 13-inch, going from the 8-core to the 10-core GPU adds $100.
- **Colors:** Sky Blue, Silver, Starlight and Midnight are offered. The page doesn't show a price difference between them.
- **Upgrades:** Memory runs from 16GB to 32GB and storage from 512GB to 4TB. I didn't see upgrade prices for either on the page, so the 24GB and 1TB configurations cost more than the starting prices above.

judge.rationale: The page state shows MacBook Air with M5 chip and prices: 13-inch from $1299 and 15-inch from $1499, matching the agent’s comparison.
